An attacker thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1556 identities would post 2646 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
